topic.title: Web Renderer & AI Chat Portal Service (renderer)
topic.shortdesc: User-facing web portal for browsing documentation sets, reading AST topics, and interacting with the integrated AI Assistant chat.

section.title: Service Overview
section.p: The renderer service provides the primary web interface on port 3000. It fetches JSON AST topic trees produced by DITA-OT and renders them dynamically into real Bootstrap components (accordions, tabs, alerts, cards, code blocks).

ul.li: Documentation Store Catalog (/) — Card grid landing page displaying all discovered documentation sets with direct navigation links.
Topic Reader View (/<docId>/<topicPath>) — Interactive topic viewer with collapsible TOC sidebar, breadcrumbs, scrollspy, and code block copy/syntax highlighting.
Integrated AI Assistant (/chat) — Real-time conversational interface connected to mcp-server for technical question-answering and live component previews.

section.title: Fallback Layout Templates (chrome.json)
section.p: When published document sets omit custom header or footer parameters, the renderer automatically uses fallback AST layout templates from data-store/data/chrome.json:

ul.li: chat-bot.header — AI Assistant header navbar template.
chat-bot.form — Prompt submission bar template in /chat.

section.title: Container Deployment & Configuration
section.p: Deploy using Docker Compose or a standalone Docker container:
section.codeblock:
# Launch using Docker Compose: docker compose up -d renderer
# Or run as a standalone Docker container: docker run -d -p 3000:3000 \ -e INTERNAL_DATA_URL=http://data-store:4000/data \ -e INTERNAL_API_URL=http://data-store:4000/api \ -e MCP_SERVER_URL=http://mcp-server:4001/mcp \ -e CHAT_BOT_PROVIDER=gemini \ -e GEMINI_API_KEY=your_api_key \ ghcr.io/jason-fox/ast-renderer:latest

plentry.pd: HTTP port for the web application (default: 3000).
Bootswatch theme name (e.g. default, darkly, journal, flatly).
Active LLM provider for /chat (gemini, anthropic, openai, ollama).
Streamable HTTP endpoint of the MCP server service (default: http://localhost:4001/mcp).
